title: Pawnos
tagline: Cute crazy eights card game vs 3 animal CPUs. Stack Draw 2 chains, share daily challenge runs.
description: Pawnos is a cute UNO-style crazy eights card game you play in your browser against three animal CPU opponents — a strawberry bunny, a matcha frog, a blueberry cat, and a lemon chick. Match the discard by color or number, drop Skip / Reverse / Draw 2 / Wild / Wild Draw 4 specials at the perfect moment, and chain Draw 2 stacks across the table to dump your hand on the next player. Play casual single-player matches in 3 to 5 minutes, or take on the Daily Challenge: a fixed shuffle and CPU script seeded fresh every midnight that everyone in the world plays the same. Compare your turns-to-clear with friends and share a tidy result card. Designed mobile-first in portrait, fully offline-capable PWA, free, no download, and friendly enough to teach kids the rules of crazy eights / UNO style card games. Includes Stack rules (Draw 2 and Wild Draw 4 can be chained), an UNO call button, soft pastel candy art, four pet mascot avatars, procedural Web Audio SFX and chill BGM, English and Japanese UI, and a clean shareable result image for the daily run.

controls.en: Tap a card in your hand to play it. Tap the deck to draw. Tap UNO when you have one card left.
controls.ja: 手札のカードをタップして出す。山札タップでドロー。残り1枚で UNO ボタン。

engineNotes: Next.js 16 App Router (Turbopack). 2D Canvas / DOM card UI (no R3F). Procedural Web Audio. Daily challenge uses date-seeded RNG so every player gets the same shuffle and CPU script. Stack rules for Draw 2 / Wild Draw 4 chains.
